title: The Harvest of This World and the Next

paragraphs.text: Allah sent down the Book in truth together with the balance, and perhaps the Hour is near. Those who do not believe in it want it to come quickly, but the believers are afraid of it because they know it is true, and those who dispute about it are far astray. Allah is gentle with His servants and gives provision to whom He wills. Whoever wants the harvest of the Hereafter will receive more, while whoever wants only the harvest of this world will be given some of it but will have no share in the Hereafter. Some people follow a religion that Allah never approved, and they will face painful punishment. The wrongdoers will fear what they earned, while the righteous will enjoy green gardens with whatever they wish near their Lord.

This is the good news Allah gives to believers who do good. The Prophet asks no payment for his message, only good will because of family ties. Whoever does a good deed receives even more good, because Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative. Some accuse him of inventing lies about Allah, but Allah could seal his heart if He willed, and He wipes out falsehood and confirms the truth. He accepts repentance, pardons bad deeds, answers the prayers of believers and gives them more from His bounty.

If Allah gave His servants too much provision, they would act unjustly on earth, so He sends down what He wills in measure. He sends rain after people lose hope, spreading His mercy. The heavens, the earth and the creatures scattered through them are His signs, and He can gather them whenever He wills. Whatever disaster strikes people is because of what their own hands earned, yet He forgives much. Nobody can escape Allah or find another helper. The ships on the sea, standing like mountains, are also His signs; if He willed, He could still the wind and leave them motionless. In this there are signs for everyone who is patient and grateful.
